solver: scipy.optimize.least_squares (trf, huber, f_scale=3, x_scale='jac', numerical jacobian)

ring.residual: per-point distance to historical CAD visible edges, /3, mean-normalised by 1/sqrt(N)
ring.edges: frozen at the initial pose during optimisation; recomputed for evaluation

controlled.truth: real Ring CAD + real W0 geometry
